description: This file defines the Subscription class within the Opencart admin mail controller namespace. It contains methods for handling subscription history updates and transaction notifications, including loading models, preparing email data, and scheduling email tasks.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class for managing subscription-related email notifications and history updates within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Handles updates to subscription history, loads relevant models, gathers customer and store info, and schedules email notifications about subscription status changes.

methods.name: transaction
methods.description: Handles subscription transaction notifications, verifies order and payment details, and schedules email alerts for subscription transactions.
